तोरणस्फाटिक

TORAṆASPHĀṬIKA . duryodhana decided to make the pāṇḍavas beggars by defeating them in a false game of dice. Dhṛtarā ṭra stood as an accomplice to that. To play the game dhṛtarāṣṭra constructed a palace and that palace was called Toraṇasph ṭika.

That diamond-studded palace had a thousand pillars and a hundred entrances. It had crystal fortresses and golden thrones in all the chambers. This palace was called Dyūtabhavana also. (Chapter 56, Sabhā Parva).
